appointment_reminder: {business}: hi {name}, a reminder of your appointment on {when}. Reply C to confirm or call us to change it. Reply STOP to opt out.
follow_up: {business}: hi {name}, thanks for visiting today. Any questions, just reply to this text. Reply STOP to opt out.
missed_call: {business}: sorry we missed your call. Reply here with what you need and we'll help. Reply STOP to opt out.
stop_confirmation: {business}: you're unsubscribed and won't get more texts from us. Reply START to opt back in.
start_confirmation: {business}: you're subscribed again. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to opt out.
help: {business}: for help call {phone} or email {email}. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.
handover: {business}: thanks, a member of our team will text or call you back shortly.
